name: OKRW
oneLiner: OKRW is the pre-launch native KRW stablecoin of Maroo, Hashed Open Finance's sovereign L1 testnet for regulated and open-path Korean Won issuance.
collateral: 1:1 Korean Won fiat reserves; dual-track regulated and open issuance paths on the Maroo L1 blockchain
pegMechanism: KRW-native Maroo model: OKRW is designed as a Korean Won stablecoin pegged 1:1 to KRW and used as the network's native fee token; Maroo's dual-track transaction model routes regulated activity through pre-approval and compliance checks while open-path activity remains permissionless
launchPhaseDetail: First sovereign L1 blockchain (Maroo) purpose-built for KRW stablecoins; testnet live May 2026; dual-track regulated and open paths; mainnet targeted before end of 2026; 1:1 Korean Won fiat-backed

featuredContent.title: Hashed Open Finance launches testnet of Maroo, first sovereign L1 for KRW stablecoins
featuredContent.description: Maroo L1 testnet goes live with OKRW as the native KRW stablecoin; dual-track regulated/open design.

milestones.title: Maroo L1 testnet launches with OKRW as native KRW stablecoin
milestones.description: First sovereign L1 blockchain purpose-built for KRW stablecoins; dual-track regulated and open paths.
